about.title: How HackDash was born
about.body: HackDash was born by accident and out of need. We were looking for a platform to track ideas through hackathons in the run-up to the <mediaParty>Hacks/Hackers Media Party</mediaParty> organized by <hhba>@HacksHackersBA</hhba>, where hackers and journalists share ideas. We spread the need through Twitter, and that was the context in which HackDash was born. <blejman>@blejman</blejman> had an idea and <dzajdband>@dzajdband</dzajdband> was interested in implementing it. So we started building the app, hoping to get to the Buenos Aires Media Party with something that didn't suck. The Media Party hackathon day came with a pleasant surprise: not only did people like HackDash, but a couple of coders picked up improving HackDash as their own hackathon project. After the Media Party we realized this small app was filling a real need. Years later, the dashboard has become a standard for tracking innovative ideas around the world.
